name: probe-bootrules
description: bootstrap bounds next to the replicate values each function sorted (traced sort.int, quantile and boot::boot), at several B and levels; T7 data with undefined resamples

rules.name: akp.effect
rules.call: WRS2::akp.effect(y ~ x, two, EQVAR = FALSE, tr = 0.2, nboot = B, alpha = 1 - conf)

rules.name: t1way
rules.call: WRS2::t1way(y ~ x, three, tr = 0.2, alpha = 1 - conf, nboot = B)

rules.name: rank_epsilon_squared
rules.call: effectsize::rank_epsilon_squared(y ~ x, three, ci = conf, alternative = "greater", iterations = B)

rules.name: dep.effect
rules.call: WRS2::dep.effect(x = paired_x, y = paired_y, tr = 0.2, nboot = B)

rules.name: kendalls_w
rules.call: effectsize::kendalls_w(y ~ x | .rowid, long, ci = conf, iterations = B)

rules.name: trimcibt
rules.call: WRS2::trimcibt(one, nv = 0.5, tr = 0.2, alpha = 1 - conf, nboot = B)

undefined.name: edge_akp_undefined
